summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by PN Smart Energy Ltd (formerly Skycorp Solar Group Ltd), a China-based solar PV product provider. It contains only the Management's Discussion and Analysis and unaudited consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The MD&A discusses revenue growth to $25.5M, an increased net loss to $7.1M driven by a non-cash equity incentive charge, and overseas sales growth. No special-situations event—acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, strategic review, tender offer, or management change—is disclosed. This is a standard periodic report with no transaction or corporate action.
